# fmt
# note a name is the same name however the marker spaced it, and an exchange
# note with no response yet gains none
>>> f.rr
notes

--   spaced   --
get https://example.com/ HTTP/1.1
x-k:1

{"a":1}
-- and the one after it --
GET https://example.com/b HTTP/1.1
host: h
>>> want f.rr
notes

-- spaced --
GET https://example.com/ HTTP/1.1
x-k: 1

{"a":1}
-- and the one after it --
GET https://example.com/b HTTP/1.1
Host: h

>>> stdout
{{root}}/f.rr
